initial_requirements: Wind-power operators need a standardized communication system for remotely supervising and operating turbines supplied by different vendors. The system should transfer measurements, status information, alarms, and other plant data to authorized operational applications and carry commands or settings back to individual turbines or wind-farm controllers. It must serve different authorized parties while keeping communication failures from disrupting the safe local operation of the plant.

turns.interviewer_utterance: What are the primary business and operational goals this standardized wind-turbine communication system must achieve, and how will you define success for the project?
turns.interviewee_utterance:
The main goal is to let operators supervise and control turbines from different vendors through one standardized way of communicating, instead of having separate solutions for each supplier. Operationally, it has to reliably move measurements, status, alarms, and commands between the turbines, wind-farm controllers, and authorized applications without compromising safe local operation if communication is lost.
We would consider it successful if operators can use it across mixed-vendor sites with fewer integration issues, consistent access to plant data, and dependable command handling under normal and degraded network conditions. It should also be clear that a communication failure does not create unsafe turbine behavior, and that only authorized parties can access the right functions and data.

slots.name: project_goals
slots.value: Provide one standardized communication way for operators to supervise and control turbines from different vendors, enabling consistent access to plant data and dependable command handling across mixed-vendor sites, including under degraded network conditions, while ensuring communication loss does not compromise safe local operation.

slots.name: stakeholder_roles
slots.value: Operators, authorized applications, turbine controllers, and wind-farm controllers; access must be limited to authorized parties.

slots.name: functional_needs
slots.value: Transfer measurements, status information, alarms, and other plant data to authorized operational applications, and carry commands or settings back to individual turbines or wind-farm controllers.

slots.name: business_rules
slots.value: Only authorized parties may access the appropriate functions and data; communication failure must not create unsafe turbine behavior or disrupt safe local operation.

slots.name: data_entities
slots.value: Measurements, status information, alarms, other plant data, commands, and settings.

slots.name: constraints
slots.value: Must work across turbines from different vendors using a standardized communication approach; communication failures must not interfere with safe local plant operation.

slots.name: quality_concerns
slots.value: Reliability, dependable command handling, consistent access to plant data, security/authorization, and safe behavior under normal and degraded network conditions.

slots.name: boundary_conditions
slots.value: If communication is lost or degraded, the system must not compromise safe local turbine operation; unsafe turbine behavior must be prevented.
